name: pass-turn
description: Two-player game where player 1 loses the last life: GAME OVER for player 1, then the turn passes to player 2 through handPlayOverToOtherPlayer (0x1226), vs MAME.
_grounding: Two credits (coin f400 + f440), 2 Players Start f520. One-shot LIVES_REMAINING 0xAD00=1 and its save block 0xAD10=1 at f650, forced death PLAYER_STATE 0xA800=0xF0 at f660 (the code a collision sweep writes). At golden f974 loseLifeAndHandOver finds no lives and posts the game-over banner; 'responded' is SEQUENCE_SUBSTEP 0xA9AC==0x08, the game-over hold (golden f974-1153). When the hold ends fileScoreAfterGameOverHoldElsePassTurn -> passTurnToOtherPlayerIfLivesElseStepSequence -> handPlayOverToOtherPlayer sets ACTIVE_PLAYER 0xAD32=1 (golden f1154) and player 2's context is loaded.
